description: Markers introducing intentionally forwarded content. Forwarded material is preserved as structured, collapsible content and is never dropped, so these patterns open a FORWARDED_CONTENT region rather than a hidden one.

patterns.pattern: ^\s*-{2,}\s*(Weitergeleitete Nachricht|Message transf.r.|Mensaje reenviado|Messaggio inoltrato|Doorgestuurd bericht|Edastatud kiri|Edasisaadetud (sõnumi|kirja).{0,20}|Пересылаемое сообщение)\s*-{2,}\s*$

patterns.comment: The 'Forwarded message' marker as SnappyMail translates it, collected from test/fixtures/clients.
patterns.pattern: ^\s*-{2,}\s*(پیام ارسال شده|رسالة معاد توجيهها|전달된 메시지|Προωθημένο μήνυμα|Препратено съобщение|Переслане повідомлення|Перасланае паведамленне|转发邮件|転送されたメッセージ|Áframsend skilaboð|Birbidalitako mezua|Mensagem Encaminhada|Persiųstas pranešimas|Pesan terusan|Posredovano sporočilo|Preposlaná správa|Thư được chuyển tiếp|Továbbított üzenet|Videresendt meddelelse|Videresendt melding|Yönlendirilmiş İleti|轉寄郵件|Välitetty viesti|Wiadomość przekazana|Пересланное сообщение|Vidarebefordrat)\s*-{2,}\s*$

patterns.comment: Yandex Mail's forward marker, in English and Russian: '-------- Beginning of forwarded message --------'.
Cypht's forward marker, translated with its interface: '----- begin forwarded message -----', '----- début du message transféré -----'. Collected from test/fixtures/clients/cypht.
patterns.pattern: ^\s*-{2,}\s*(begin forwarded message|göndərilmiş mesajın başlanğıcı|Nachrichtweiterleiten beginnen|comenzar mensaje de reenvío|edastatud kirja algus|پیام ارسالی را شروع کنید|début du message transféré|Mulai pesan yang diteruskan|Begin geforward bericht|początek przekazanej wiadomości|iniciar mensagem encaminhada)\s*-{2,}\s*$
